copy.blurb:
This is a Pick. Belgium v IR Iran in FIFA World Cup 2026 on Sunday, and the model and the market disagree on the IR Iran side by +12.8pp. That's the gap the verdict rests on.

On Elo, Belgium comes in 120 points ahead — Belgium at 1860, IR Iran at 1740. Both Elo numbers are pulled live from the public Elo source. No host, home-ground, or altitude adjustments apply here; the prior reads straight from Elo.

Three-way split from the model: Belgium to win at 51%, the draw at 23%, and IR Iran to win at 26%. The Desk's three-way distribution is calibrated against the W/D/L resolution Polymarket and Kalshi settle on, not against the exact scoreline. IR Iran sits at 26% of the mass.

On the same three-way, Polymarket: Belgium to win at 67%, the draw at 22%, and IR Iran to win at 13%. Reading those three numbers as a probability distribution, the market's view is internally consistent. The disagreement with the model is concentrated on the IR Iran side — 13% on the market, 26% on the engine, a +12.8pp gap.

Bootstrap discipline matters most on the longshots — wide bands on small point estimates collapse the Pick rate fast. On IR Iran the lower bound is 21%, which keeps the lower-bound gap at +8.0pp against the market — past +3pp, so the Pick clears. The Desk's posture is that calibration sits with the closing market across recent fixtures — we're not claiming the market is generally wrong, only that this side, on this fixture, looks mispriced. Selection is the dimension this verdict adds value on.

The number above is the most recent read; it isn't frozen. With kickoff roughly 33 days out, the model is on the weekly refresh cadence; we'll move to daily once we cross the T-5d window. Injury news, the actual XI, and weather conditions at kickoff all feed back into the prior when they land. We republish on every refresh. The Desk surfaces edge; what to do with that surface is a reader's call.
drivers: Pre-tournament Elo gives IR Iran a stronger prior than the Polymarket line implies.
The +12.8pp gap clears our 3 percentage point threshold for a Pick.
Calibration sits with the closing market across recent fixtures, so selection is the lever.
Late-binding signals — form, confirmed XI, weather — re-evaluate closer to kickoff.
copy.summary: A +12.8pp gap across model and market on the IR Iran side. Our Elo prior, after host and altitude adjustments, rates IR Iran at 26%; Polymarket sits at 13%.
copy.title: Belgium v IR Iran · the model leans IR Iran
